name: 高中物理可视化
description: 2D physics engine for Chinese high-school physics with AI scene JSON + canvas visualization.

zh.name: 高中物理可视化
zh.description: 覆盖高中物理力学/振动波动/电磁/光学/热学/近代物理的 2D 可视化；AI 输出 scene JSON 并驱动播放。

en.name: High-school Physics
en.description: 2D visualizer covering Chinese high-school physics; AI outputs scene JSON and drives playback.

tools.name: phys_validate
tools.description: Validate a physics scene JSON against the schema. Returns {ok, errors[]}. Always validate before phys_load; on failure, fix the JSON and retry.

tools.name: phys_load
tools.description: Load a physics scene JSON into the visualizer (opens the panel). Scene fields: topic, zh, world{xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,air}, g, bodies[{id,x,y,vx,vy,mass,radius,q,color,label,fixed,bounce,e,mu,mu0}], springs[{a,b,k,rest,damping}], fields[{type:'E',Ex,Ey | mag,angle | U,d,angle}, {type:'B',Bz | mag,dir:'out'|'in'}], walls[{x1,y1,x2,y2,bounce,mu,mu0}], planet{G,M,R}, modules[{kind,<params>}] (kinds: projectile,incline,circular,pendulum,spring,collision,gravitation,shm,wave,plates,circuit,transformer,induction,refraction,lens,mirror,gas,photoelectric,decay — call phys_list_params for every parameter, unit and range), optics{rays,mirrors,lenses,interfaces}, circuit{type:'RC'|'AC',...}, plots[{id,of:'body.prop'}], dt. Coordinates: +x right, +y up; gravity pulls -y.

tools.name: phys_step
tools.description: Advance a few simulation steps while paused.

tools.name: phys_reset
tools.description: Reset the scene to its initial state.

tools.name: phys_state
tools.description: Read current simulation state (t, body positions/velocities, circuit).

tools.name: phys_list_examples
tools.description: List built-in example scenes covering Chinese high-school physics topics.

tools.name: phys_load_example
tools.description: Load a built-in example by id (from phys_list_examples).

tools.name: phys_set_param
tools.description: Set ONE parameter and apply live. Module scene: {module:0,key:'v0',value:20} (or path 'modules[0].v0'; aliases such as frequency/speed/wavelength work). Body scene: dotted path e.g. bodies[0].mass, g, world.air, springs[0].k, fields[0].mag, walls[0].mu0. Out-of-range values return an error with the allowed range.

tools.name: phys_update
tools.description: Update several parameters at once: {changes:{'modules[0].v0':20,'modules[0].angle':30}} or a single {path|key,value}. Same validation as phys_set_param.

tools.name: phys_list_params
tools.description: List every customisable parameter of the loaded module scene (key, Chinese name, unit, min, max, enum, current value) and all module kinds. Call this before phys_set_param when unsure of a key.
